title.narrative: Education Quality and Coverage Improvement Program
Programa Para el Mejoramiento de la Cobertura y Calidad Educativa

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es apoyar los esfuerzos de mejoramiento de la educacin preprimaria y primaria a nivel nacional. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) aumentar la cobertura con calidad del nivel de educacin preprimario; y (ii) contribuir a mejorar la calidad de la educacin preprimaria y primaria.

The program's objective is to support efforts to improve preprimary and primary education at the national level. The specific objectives are to: (i) increase coverage and quality in preprimary schools; and (ii) help improve the quality of preprimary and primary education.
